title: Signal: SHA-1 use via Digest::SHA1.hexdigest (ruby) — review required
scope: Single-line lexical match on the Digest::SHA1.hexdigest call in ruby code.
limitations: Lexical, line-based: matches any Digest::SHA1.hexdigest call regardless of purpose. Name-selected SHA-1 and other weak algorithms are separate rules.
fpNotes: Git object ids, legacy protocol interop, and checksums are the common false positives.
